neighbours.label: ' matter' in the concessive 'no matter how/what/who' (and nearby function words of the concessive frame)
fire: The rent stays the same, no matter how many people share the flat.
He answers every letter himself, no matter who sends it.
The bridge stays open all winter, no matter what the weather does.
Our refund policy is simple: no matter how long you have had the item, you can return it.
She kept her promise, no matter how hard it became.
The coach plays the same lineup no matter which team they face.
Prices are fixed at the door, no matter how busy the night gets.
The app saves your work, no matter where you are when the signal drops.
quiet: The rent stays the same for each person who shares the flat.
He answers every letter himself within a week.
The bridge stays open all winter thanks to the heaters.
Our refund policy is simple: you can return the item within thirty days.
She kept her promise even when it became very hard to do.
The coach plays the same lineup against every team they face.
Soil rich in organic matter holds water well during dry weeks.
We will discuss the subject matter of the course on Monday.

notes: Probe: 'no matter how' 0.72 (peak ' matter'); 'not for lack of' 0.40, 'but it still managed to' 0.38, 'little indication of' 0.30, but another concessive ('not out of pride but out of habit') 0.04 and 'yet it still' 0.006, so the broader concessive label was inconsistent; only 'no matter' was clean. Plain same-topic contrasts 0.03-0.14 but 'planted it for practicality' 0.27. Two near misses keep the bare token ' matter' in a non-concessive sense (organic matter, subject matter) to test the word without the frame.
